Exclude similarly named but unrelated entities. Return unknown if entity alignment cannot be verified. Cite every retained source. authority.answer:
ALIASES: WILDWOOD 原木燒烤餐廳 | WILDWOOD

The exact entity behind wildwood.com.tw is only weakly supported by public sources: multiple Taiwanese pages identify the site as the official website for “WILDWOOD 原木燒烤餐廳” in Taipei, with the same domain and matching contact details[2][8][11][14]. A PDF on wildwood.com.tw also appears to be an official menu for the same brand[13]. Unknown whether the suspended site currently resolves to the same active operator, because the suspension page itself was not publicly verifiable here.
